SELECT
DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%x-W%v') DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m') AS period, status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM tasks WHERE creator_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = false AND task_type != 'WBS_TASK' AND created_at >= #{from} AND created_at <= #{to} GROUP BY period, status ORDER BY period, status

SELECT * FROM tasks WHERE creator_id = #{userId} AND task_type = 'TODO' AND status NOT IN ('DONE', 'CANCELLED') AND is_deleted = false ORDER BY FIELD(priority, 'HIGH', 'MEDIUM', 'LOW'), end_date IS NULL, end_date, created_at DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT DISTINCT t.* FROM tasks t LEFT JOIN task_assignees ta ON t.id = ta.task_id WHERE t.is_deleted = false AND t.task_type = 'EVENT' AND t.start_date < DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
AND (t.end_date >= CURDATE() OR (t.end_date IS NULL AND t.start_date >= CURDATE())) AND (t.creator_id = #{userId} OR ta.user_id = #{userId}) ORDER BY t.start_date
